summary.text: Mike Soter, listed by Ballotpedia as Michael Soter, is a Republican state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 8th Worcester District since January 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is the ranking minority member of the Joint Committees on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies and on Higher Education.

paragraphs.text: Soter assumed office on January 2, 2019, succeeding Kevin Kuros, and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Human Resources and Employee Engagement Committee and the Joint Committee on Cannabis Policy, and he is the ranking minority member of the Joint Committees on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies and on Higher Education.
